opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Small Grants – UK
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring UK and Japan together across arts, culture, humanities, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport. Grants typically £1,500‑£5,000, up to £6,000 exceptional.

opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; practitioners, managers, carers in health fields are also welcome. Preference for those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration and early‑career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Annual award supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK. Up to £10,000 per year for projects up to three years (max £30,000).
